summary: Okaloosa County entry named only in a lookout directory; the likeliest directory page gives the name and nothing else, and no source describes it today.

evidence.supports: The directory's Florida index lists Sand Hill in Okaloosa County
The likeliest of three directory Sand Hill pages (the only one without a county) gives the name only

notes_for_editor: Sand Hill is a common name, and the directory has other Sand Hill pages for towers elsewhere. The Alabama page (sand-hill.html) gives Clarke County; the New York page (sand-hill1.html) gives St Lawrence County. The National Historic Lookout Register lists an Alabama Sandhill Lookout in Clarke County (US 1593, AL 77). None of these is this Florida tower. The Okaloosa County assignment comes only from the directory index. The Florida index's Sand Hill entry has no link, and sand-hill2.html is the only one of the three Sand Hill pages without a county, so linking that page to this record is by elimination, not by a direct link. The record coordinates (30.9629, -86.67588) were not checked against a map. The USGS-based GNIS place file lists a different populated place called Sand Hill in Walton County at about 30.84 N, 86.19 W, which is not this record's location. No register, news item or second source describes this tower; two searches found none. Possible checks: Okaloosa County and Florida Forest Service records, and Choctawhatchee area newspapers.
